text: {"lessons":["My early sales locked in gains, but average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding and my overall plan.","After buying four stocks in Period 7, I saw account value fall and then recover before dipping again. Short-term moves are uncertain, so I should avoid reacting to every fluctuation.","Before buying, I should check that the trade fits my cash and portfolio plan; holding remains a valid choice when I have no clear reason to act."]}
